firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently finished reading a novel starts.
clarifications: Everyone draws a first hand of five cards before play.
This is the original Paperback word game, not Paperback Adventures or the tenth anniversary edition.
internalEvidence: Rendered the image-only publisher-authored original English rulebook from the archive. Page 4 names the recent novel reader, the five-card initial hand and clockwise play. The booklet’s starting deck and Fame card setup match inventory BGG 141572. SHA-256: 0dab6b4d70d0d99c288c426d38b86769cd156c113d7c5c0e731885e6eb100433. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the cited rendered pages, opening instruction, game identity and edition.
uncertainty: The booklet states no tie procedure for players who finished novels at the same time.

image.alt: Paperback original game title artwork by illustrator Ryan Goldsberry, showing Paige Turner at a typewriter

fairUse.rationale: Small artist-hosted title artwork identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Ryan Goldsberry hosts this title illustration on his own Paperback The Game portfolio page https://ryangoldsberry.com/paperback-the-game. The portfolio dates the project to 2014 and also shows the original Fowers Games book-shaped box. The character, typewriter, and title visually match the original game identity; this image is artist promotional artwork, not a photo of the box. Reduced to 360 pixels wide for display.
